dialogs.text: "...By the order of the Guardian of the{RUBY#[D]Yajaw K'ahk'} Sacred Flame, and the most benevolent and glorious Holy Sov{RUBY#[D]Ti'sakhuun}ereign, His Ma{RUBY#[D]Kalomte}jesty Och-Kan, labor is now being recruited from all tribes for the construction of water conservation infrastructure..."
"...No fixed quotas, with all being based on voluntary participation... Building the alliance... We hope all tribes will actively respond..."

"By the order of the Guardian of the{RUBY#[D]Yajaw K'ahk'} Sacred Flame, and the most benevolent and glorious Holy Sov{RUBY#[D]Ti'sakhuun}ereign, His Ma{RUBY#[D]Kalomte}jesty Och-Kan, the cursed land is hereby sealed off, effective immediately. All members of the alliance are strictly prohibited from entering."
"Those who enter without authorization will be officially recognized as enemies of the alliance. This is the joint declaration of (...) Nanatzcayan, Meztli, Huitztlan, and Teteocan."
"Glory forever unto to the Guardian of the{RUBY#[D]Yajaw K'ahk'} Sacred Flame, the Great Pe{RUBY#[D]Q'atal Tzij}acemaker the most benevolent Holy Sov{RUBY#[D]Ti'sakhuun}ereign Och-Kan."
"Given the slow overall progress of the drainage works in this area, minor adjustments are being made to the rotation system to ensure the alliance's inexorable triumph."
"Workers will be divided into three teams, each team working sixteen hours, rotating every two days. Teams with exceptional performance will receive extra grain provisions."

"The triumphant victory of <color=#00E1FFFF>draining the accumulated water</color> is close at hand. Once the ditches are completed, the <color=#00E1FFFF>water pump</color> can operate normally. Push a little harder!"
"...Compatriots, family, brothers and sisters who have dedicated themselves to the alliance's inexorable triumph..."
"...The most benevolent... has allocated a batch of new mechanisms from (...) to support transportation, (...) and <color=#00E1FFFF>underwater salvage</color>..."
"...Forward! Forward! Move forward at all costs... For the glorious future of the alliance, for our freedom and glory, for a homeland free from the evil dragons's oppression..."
"...Without permission... it is forbidden to operate the <color=#00E1FFFF>control lever</color>... Accidental falls... have already caused the deaths of three workers..."
"...There's a small trail behind a stone wall to the north that leads to the top of the waterfall. It can be used as a <color=#00E1FFFF>storage area</color>..."
"...I left a few marks, just in case I forget the way later..."

"...Sayani's injuries took a turn for the worse. The humidity's to blame... I told her to rest, but she laughed it off... saying it would slow the squad down, resulting in everyone missing out on extra provisions..."
"...Once night falls, I'll sneak up to her with a torch to cauterize her wound while the others aren't watching, or her limbs will rot, too..."
"...May glory eternal be... Peacemaker... Most benevolent... Och-Kan..."

...Artisans Mahutzintl, Tlanalco, and... those responsible for the construction of the water pump... deliberately slowed down, causing delays... The benevolent... imposed no punishment... only suspended rations for three weeks...

"...The <color=#00E1FFFF>stone key</color> that activates the <color=#00E1FFFF>water pump mechanism</color>... is kept at... no one is allowed to use it without permission... until other artisans are assigned..."
"...The secret... necessary sacrifices... anything it takes..."
(Most of the rest of the content has been burned and is illegible.)
On closer inspection, it does seem odd that the only empty jar is the one in front of this Monetoo...
Did the other Monetoo find what they were looking for but this one didn't?
#Poor thing... C'mon, {NICKNAME}, let's help it find the stuff that was meant to fit in this jar... Hmm. What would that be, though?
(Place)
Top Flying Scorer — Matahga
Top Flying Scorer — Acomitl
Top Flying Scorer — Manyoya
The Soaring Saurian is open all day! If you wish to join Matahga's special training, then come lift off from the Soaring Saurian! Note:
Up with serious, rigorous training! Down with sloth and slacking!
Laze about today, and be as trash tomorrow!
Only those who push forward boldly shall truly know greatness as Saurian riders!
The code is: Blow the left horn first, then the right one, then the left again, and finally the right... but blow 'em at your own peril!
Feeding a Saurian some Fowl is the best way to keep one in a good mood and avoid getting pecked!
(Seems like a reminder that someone called Matahga left for themselves. You can feel the intensity of the emotion in their words.)
(But surely putting exclamation marks at the end of every reminder is the same as putting none... Isn't it?)
(A romance novel written by Dorothy Leeckson. On its faded cover, a woman lies on a bed surrounded by flowers.)
(After skimming through the book, you feel warm and content, but haven't gained any useful insights.)
So... Was it her family's gardener or her best friend's cousin's brother-in-law?... Ugh, Paimon's head hurts!
(The biography of Frank Drebin, retired Inspector of Fontaine's Marechaussee Phantom special police force. Yep, the Inspector is a vigorous white cat.)
(A big cat paw print is imprinted on the title page of this book, perhaps a special memento the Inspector has left for his subordinates.)
Seriously... Might as well write a book about Paimon too, called... The White-Haired Detective!
(A work by Fontainian playwright, Jean Brooklyn. A book this thick can totally be used by shorter people to increase their height.)
(A photo album that doesn't seem rather popular. It's filled with images of beautiful young ladies.)
Hmph... Just pictures of girls? Boring!
Umm, this doesn't look to be the right thing...
Ah, so this is what we're looking for — something with red in it!
Wait... Huh? The stuff we threw in is gone... We did chuck something in, right? Something doesn't feel quite right here...
Is there something else in the jar?
(Knock on the jar)
(Childish, scribbled writings are visible:)
This game's called "Bing Bong Ding Dong," and here's the rules:
1. When the Bing Bong Monetoo isn't ding-donging, ride on the Saurian statue's back to make it move forward.
2. Get off the Saurian statue when the Bing Bong Monetoo counts down to a "ding!" or you'll lose.
3. First one to run to the Bing Bong Monetoo wins!
And don't give me that "isn't this just Red Light, Green Light?" crap. Rules are important, and it's precisely because you don't respect the rules that you can't win!
